metadata.title: One Potential Factor Weighing on Meta Today: a Job Posting at Apple

content.text:
21 hours ago
One Potential Factor Weighing on Meta Today: a Job Posting at Apple
While the slide in Anthropic shares and broader tech selloff are dragging down Meta’s stock (down about 4% today), a new competitive threat from Apple may also be having an impact.
An Apple job posting from this week suggests the company might be aiming to build a tool similar to Meta’s viral Muse AI agent tool.
